The Justice Department has removed bulk ZIP downloads from its online Epstein Library , forcing users to access documents one PDF at a time and making large-scale independent review of the records far more difficult. As of Feb. 6 , the department’s “DOJ Disclosures” page no longer displays ZIP files, which previously allowed users to download large batches of compressed documents at once. The site still allows users to search the database, but results are viewable only by opening individual PDFs. With millions of pages in the collection, the change makes comprehensive review a slow, manual process.
